clients.title: Clients
clients.description: The companies your agency fills roles for. Each agency job is for one of them.
clients.emptyFilteredText: Try another name, industry or city.
clients.deleteText: The client leaves your list. A client with jobs stays, because those jobs and their placements name it.

start.title: Add the companies you recruit for
start.text: Every agency job is for a client. Add them once and pick one when you post a job.

steps.title: Add a client
steps.text: Its name, and if you like its industry, city and logo.

steps.title: Link it if it is on EU Jobs
steps.text: So rules about the same client recognise it exactly.

steps.title: Post jobs for it
steps.text: Choose the client in the job's agency terms.

dialog.description: Only the name is needed. Candidates see the client's name on a job only when you choose to show it.
dialog.link: The same company on EU Jobs (optional)
dialog.linkHint: Type at least 2 letters of its name.
dialog.noCompanies: No verified company with that name.

talent.title: Talent
talent.description: The candidates on your books, people asking to join, and the agreement they sign.
talent.removeText: They can no longer be placed by your agency. A placement that is running continues to its end.
talent.noAgreement: Publish your agreement before you take anyone on. Requests wait until then.

books.title: Nobody on your books yet
books.text: Invite candidates from their profile, or accept the people who ask to join.

requests.title: No requests
requests.text: Candidates who ask to join, and people you invite, show here until they agree.

agreement.deleteText: The draft's PDF and its rules are removed. The current version stays as it is.
agreement.draftLead: Check the four rules below against your PDF, then publish. Candidates on your books are asked to agree to a new version before their next placement.
agreement.currentLead: Published {{date}} · {{agreed}} of {{total}} on your books agreed to it
agreement.aiText: AI finds the four rules in your PDF and quotes the clause each comes from. You check them before publishing.
agreement.aiDone: AI read this PDF on {{when}}. Check its reading below.
agreement.readDone: AI read the PDF. Check each rule and its clause.
agreement.noText: This PDF has no text to read (a scan). Type the rules below instead.
agreement.published: Published. Candidates on your books will be asked to agree to it.

start.title: Upload the agreement candidates sign
start.text: Candidates join your books by agreeing to it. Its rules decide whether someone on a placement may take other work.

steps.title: Upload the PDF
steps.text: Your agency agreement or terms of engagement.

steps.title: Check the rules
steps.text: AI reads them on Agency Plus; you can also type them.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Then invite candidates or accept their requests.

rules.title: Contract rules

help.exclusivity: What the candidate may do while an assignment runs.
help.noticeDays: Days of notice the candidate gives to end an assignment early.
help.coolingOffDays: Days after an assignment before they may work for that client directly or through another agency.
help.maxWeeklyHours: The most hours a week across all their jobs.

rules.clauseHint: Copied word for word from the PDF.

contract.title: Contract (optional)
contract.lead: The contract for this job. Once you confirm its rules they apply to this job's placements before your agreement's.
contract.aiText: AI can read the rules of this contract and quote each clause (Agency Plus).

terms.showClient: Show the client's name to candidates
terms.showClientHint: Leave it off to show "Confidential client". Your agency's name always shows.
terms.hoursHint: Left empty, a {{type}} job counts as {{count}} hours a week.
terms.contractHint: Your agreement sets the rules for every job. Add a contract here only when this job needs different rules: its confirmed rules come first for placements on this job.
terms.clientSearchEmpty: No clients yet. Add the companies you recruit for.
terms.contractAfterSave: You can attach a contract for this job after the first step is saved.

placements.title: Placements
placements.description: The people your agency has placed, the offers you made and placements that are over.
placements.rulesOnAccept: The rules are set when the candidate accepts.
placements.endText: Pick the new last day (today at the soonest). Rules that count from the end count from this day.
placements.endDateInvalid: Choose a day from today up to before the current end.
placements.rehireText: Pick one of your published agency jobs. Its dates, rate and contract apply; they accept or decline.
placements.noOpenJobs: You have no published agency job that starts from today. Publish one first.

running.title: Nothing running
running.text: Placements show here while they run.

upcoming.title: Nothing upcoming
upcoming.text: Placements that have not started yet show here.

offered.title: No open offers
offered.text: Re-hire offers waiting for an answer show here.

over.title: Nothing over yet
over.text: When a placement ends you can re-hire the person from here.

start.title: Your placements start here
start.text: A placement starts when you move someone on your books to Hired on an agency job.

steps.title: Publish your agreement
steps.text: Candidates agree to it to join your books.

steps.title: Post an agency job
steps.text: With its client, dates and pay rate.

steps.title: Hire
steps.text: Move the applicant to Hired; the placement appears here.

next.title: Fits next
next.none: None of your published jobs starting after {{date}} fits them yet.

candidate.title: Agencies
candidate.description: Your placements through agencies, offers waiting for you and the agencies whose books you are on.
candidate.rulesIntro: EU Jobs applies these rules, from the job’s contract or the agency’s agreement, quoted word for word.

notice.title: Give notice on {{job}}
notice.text: Your placement ends after the notice period in your contract. You cannot take this back.

offer.agreement_pending: Agree to {{agency}}’s latest agreement first, from My agencies.
offer.not_on_books: You are no longer on {{agency}}’s books. Ask to join again from My agencies.

offers.title: No offers
offers.text: When an agency offers you another placement, it shows here to accept or decline.

agencies.title: No agencies yet
agencies.text: Ask to join an agency from one of its jobs, or accept an agency’s invitation.

placements.title: No placements yet
placements.text: When an agency hires you for one of its jobs, the placement shows here with its dates and rules.

start.title: Work through agencies
start.text: Agencies place people on short-term work for their client companies. Join an agency’s books from one of its jobs; once you agree to its agreement it can place you.

membership.newVersion: Version {{version}} is waiting for your agreement
membership.leaveText: The agency can no longer place you. A placement that is running continues to its end. You can ask to join again later.

agreement.title: {{agency}} agreement
agreement.noPreview: The PDF cannot be shown here. Open it to read it.
agreement.check: I have read and agree to version {{version}} of {{agency}}’s agreement.
agreement.changed: The agency published version {{version}} while you were reading. Read it before you agree.
agreement.already: You already agreed to this version.

lock.title: You can take this job from {{date}}

join.hint: An agency can only place you once you are on its books and have agreed to its agreement.

ranking.title: Best from your books
ranking.text: People on your books, best match for this job first. Anyone on a placement during these dates is left out.
ranking.disclaimer: AI wrote these lines from each profile; the order comes from the match score. Check the profile before you offer.
ranking.offerText: {{start}} to {{end}}, with this job's rate and contract. They accept or decline on their Agencies page, and your rules are checked again when they accept.
ranking.publishFirst: Publish this job to offer it to someone on your books.
ranking.hidden_one: {{count}} person on your books is on a placement during these dates.
ranking.hidden_other: {{count}} people on your books are on a placement during these dates.
ranking.empty: Nobody is on your books yet.
ranking.allBusy: Everyone on your books is on a placement during these dates.

jobRules.applies: Your agreement, version {{version}}, applies to this job:
jobRules.noAgreementText: Candidates join your books by agreeing to your agreement, and only people on your books can be placed. Publish it in Talent › Agreement before you hire for this job.
jobRules.defaultExclusivity: No other agency job at the same time
jobRules.order: For each rule: this job’s confirmed contract comes first, then your agreement, then the default.
jobRules.scope: This agreement covers all your jobs. A job can also have its own contract (job › Agency terms): its confirmed rules come before these for that job’s placements.

setup.title: Set up your agency
setup.text: Do these in order: each step opens the page where you do it, and the next one unlocks when it is done.

client.title: Add a client
client.text: The companies you recruit for. Every agency job is for one client.

agreement.title: Publish your agreement
agreement.text: Candidates join your books by agreeing to it, and its rules protect each placement.

job.title: Post an agency job
job.text: Pick the client, the dates, the pay rate and the hours, then publish.
job.locked: Add a client first: every agency job is for one client.

books.title: Get people on your books
books.text: Invite candidates, or accept the people who ask to join when they apply.
books.locked: Publish your agreement first: candidates join your books by agreeing to it.

placement.title: Make your first placement
placement.text: Move someone on your books to Hired on an agency job; the placement runs on the job’s dates.
placement.locked: Post an agency job and get someone on your books first.

setup.jobsText: An agency job is always for one of your clients, so add a client first. Here is the whole flow.
setup.placementsText: A placement starts when you hire someone from your books on an agency job. Here is what comes before it.
